name: computer-use
description: How to operate a computer — the capabilities an agent needs to reach past its own text output and act on a real machine. Currently browser control with automatic framework selection and degradation, and rich human-readable document artifacts with a local preview.

interface.shortDescription: Browser control with graceful degradation, and rich document artifacts
interface.longDescription: Capabilities for acting on a real machine rather than only describing what to do. graceful-browser picks the browser automation stack that is genuinely available in the current session and degrades transparently when a higher-priority one is not; a Chrome DevTools MCP server ships with the plugin so there is something to degrade to. mdx-artifact turns content into a componentized MDX document and serves a local preview for a human to read.
defaultPrompt: Open this page and take a screenshot of the dashboard
Turn these findings into a good-looking document and start a preview
